brief:
Settlers stole a flock of sheep from the village of Salwad, located northeast of Ramallah, according to Ma'an news agency. The theft adds to ongoing incidents of livestock rustling attributed to Israeli settlers in Palestinian areas.

The village of Salwad has faced repeated incidents of property loss and damage. Settlers' activities in the region have drawn repeated Palestinian complaints to international observers and Israeli authorities.
title: Settlers steal sheep from Salwad village northeast of Ramallah
